title: FyntraX Optimized
description: FyntraX Optimized modpack for better and smoother Minecraft experience
body:
A simple Minecraft modpack focusing on performance and graphics enhancements.



![FyntraXOptimized Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a96ea786866207e36c8a56c0a11d97fe2d0080d_0.webp)


### Performance

FyntraX Optimized is one of the faster game clients, thanks to modern performance mods like Sodium, Lithium, and others. The bundled mods have been carefully selected to be safe in your worlds and provide noticeable speed benefits on any device.

### Always up to date

FyntraX Optimized receives fast updates and stands as one of the first modpacks to upgrade to newer Minecraft versions.

## This modpack is built only for Fabric!
